description:
One-shot final-state repair emphasizing near-tied HOST text predictions, version2.

Version1 was rejected by an absolute post-branch-change cutoff of1. This
version evaluates a global protected-head logit bound on the recorded format
features. Floating model behavior still requires the official forward meter.

All targets are paired, unlabeled calibration HOST states. Five fixed margin
weight exponents, donor counts and ridges define independent closed-form
solves from the same original target. No residual refitting or arithmetic
answers are used. Only native final Down coefficients change; every programme
coefficient and all gates, Up rows and gains remain bit-identical to A98.

extra.selection_metric: Calibration HOST top8 rivals; full vocabulary checked below.
extra.format_check: Real-arithmetic protected-head norm bound on recorded features; official forward still required.
